item.title: HK Flower Market property owners disappointed with redevelopment offers
item.description: Residents and florists have expressed their disappointment over acquisition offers from the Urban Renewal Authority (URA) to purchase homes and shops affected by the controversial redevelopment of the Flower Market.

item.title: 8 stalls closed at Hong Kong’s FarmFest over non-self-produced goods
item.description: Hong Kong authorities have suspended exhibitors at an agricultural showcase over the weekend after they were suspected of selling products that they did not produce themselves. item.title: ‘Are You Dead?’: Chinese check-in app for solo dwellers goes viral
item.description: “Are You Dead?”, an app that sounds the alarm if a user doesn’t check in every 48 hours, was one of China’s top-selling paid apps on Tuesday as the country’s growing class of solo dwellers flocked to download it.
